evals.prompt: Review this NDA for Copperfin Robotics, Inc. Copperfin will share its own information. Use the default playbook.
evals.expected_output: A review in the template's layout, rated Red, with 4 Must fix, 6 Should fix and 3 Note rows, the audit clause under Not covered by the playbook, Exhibit A under Could not check, and every quote word for word from the NDA.
expectations: The header says the fictional default playbook was used.
The four Must fix rows are exclusions (clause 3), term (clause 7), non-solicitation (clause 9) and indemnity (clause 10), and they come before every other row.
The six Should fix rows are clauses 2, 4, 6, 8, 11 and 12.
Governing law (16) and assignment (15) are rated Note, and the missing publicity or no-obligation clause is a Note row marked Not found in the NDA.
Clause 13 (Compliance Audits) appears under Not covered by the playbook and is not rated.
Exhibit A appears under Could not check.
Every quoted NDA passage appears word for word in fictional-nda-01.md.
No row raises the whistleblower immunity notice.
Every suggested fix moves the clause toward the playbook's preferred position or a fallback, for Copperfin's side.
